messages:
IncidentBot: paging: HIGH severity — inference-frontend returned 503s for multiple customers in us-west-2. Alerts triggered at 2024-08-22T04:07:03Z. Priya Shah: oncall here, grabbing it. logging in to the cluster now. Miguel Torres: looking at autoscaler logs, I see a spike in queue depth + OOM on a worker pool. Priya Shah: starting mitigation: scaling to backup pool, routing to older model variant as fallback. DeployBot: rolling rollback triggered for last non-breaking deploy (deploy-2024-08-22T03:50) by @Priya Shah. Sara Kim: heads-up for CS — affected customers list? Miguel Torres: initial list: acct-993, acct-441, acct-71 (low qps but some timeouts), plus two bigger tenants acct-220 and acct-558 experiencing errors for ~14m. Emily Zhao: pinging accounts for those two customers now, will say we’re aware and mitigating. Priya Shah: live note for status page: "Partial API outage for generation endpoints in us-west-2. Mitigation in progress; some requests may return 503 or increased latency. Investigating root cause." Sara Kim: can we get a short RCA draft for customers after we close? they want timeline + actions. Miguel Torres: preliminary root cause: memory leak in runtime's KV cache eviction path triggered under specific seq-length+batch combo. Reproducer attached to thread. Priya Shah: we need to confirm repro and whether rollback fixed it. Miguel Torres: rollback removed memory pressure; after fallback routing and rollback the error rate dropped to baseline at 04:21Z. Priya Shah: ok — timeline block for follow-up email. Miguel Torres: putting quick timeline here so CS can vet:

- 04:07Z: IncidentBot alerts — surge of 503s in us-west-2
- 04:08–04:12Z: on-call triage; mitigation: route to backup pool + start rollback
- 04:14Z: rollback (deploy-2024-08-22T03:50) initiated
- 04:21Z: error rate returned to baseline; monitoring stabilized
- 04:30Z: post-rollback validation complete; no further regressions seen

Priya Shah: that's great. Sara, Emily — can you draft the customer follow-up using this timeline + short RCA + actions? keep it concise and customer-facing. Sara Kim: starting a draft, will paste here for review. Emily Zhao: will attach list of impacted tenants and recommended credits if needed. Sara Kim: DRAFT CUSTOMER NOTE:

"Hi — we experienced a partial interruption to the generation API in us-west-2 on 2024-08-22. Root cause: an issue in the runtime's KV cache eviction that caused excess memory usage under a particular request pattern, leading to worker failures and 503 responses. What we did: our on-call team rolled back to a prior deploy and routed traffic to a backup pool to restore service. Timeline: [include timeline]. What we’re doing to prevent recurrence: 1) patch to fix eviction logic and add guardrails (in progress); 2) improved autoscaler thresholds and out-of-memory detection; 3) expanded canary coverage for the model+seq-length mix that triggered this; 4) additional alerting for memory anomalies. We regret the disruption and are available for a one-on-one technical review if you’d like." Priya Shah: good. two edits: call out exact customer impact (eg, request failures and delayed responses) and offer a specific credit path. Emily Zhao: adding: "Affected customers may request a credit — contact cs@redwood.ai with your account id and incident reference 1719204823." Miguel Torres: I'll follow up with the engineering postmortem and attach logs + patch PR once tests pass. Sara Kim: internal note for status page update and public summary. Can we also provide a short internal comms template for account teams? Drafting below. Priya Shah: yes please — include suggested subject line and one-liner. Sara Kim: INTERNAL COMM TEMPLATE:

Subject: Incident 1719204823 — us-west-2 partial generation outage (resolved)
One-liner: Resolved partial outage impacting generation API in us-west-2; rollback and routing restored service. Impact: some customers saw 503s or higher latencies between 04:07–04:21Z. Action for AE/CS: proactively reach out to impacted customers, offer credit path and a technical debrief if requested. Link to internal RCA: <link-to-postmortem>

Priya Shah: perfect. Emily, do we need legal/EIP signoff on credit wording? Emily Zhao: small check with finance but standard CS credit template is fine. I'll file the credit request flow and include it in the customer email. Miguel Torres: follow-up engineering actions (for postmortem):
- PR to fix KV eviction logic (in review)
- Add memory headroom metrics + OOM alert (done)
- Add regression test for seq-length batching combo (in progress)
- Backport hotfix to Dedicated clusters (planning)

Priya Shah: assign owners? Miguel => PR + tests. Eng-infra => autoscaler tuning ticket (I'll create). Sara => customer comms send + credits. Emily => finance verification. Priya Shah: tagging for post-incident review next Tue 1600 PT. Miguel Torres: I'll attach logs and the minimal repro snippet here once CI finishes. Sara Kim: final pass on customer note and I'll send to impacted customers and paste copy to status page update. Priya Shah: thanks all — great coordination. closing this handoff thread, will create the postmortem doc and link it to the internal RCA once ready. :white_check_mark:
